title: Exploring the mechanism of action of Qian Lie Xing Fang during the treatment of benign prostatic hyperplasia via network pharmacology and molecular dynamics simulation analyses.
authors: Xiang, Jingjing; Li, Zefei; Wang, Chaoyang
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子动力学研究中药复方治疗良性前列腺增生，虽涉及AR/PDE-5蛋白与小分子对接，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，仅泛提DNA转录因子结合，与本课题TF-DNA机制研究关联微弱。
abstract: This study aimed to explore the historical research progress on benign prostatic hyperplasia from the perspective of traditional Chinese medicine theory and the treatment of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) with Qian Lie Xing Fang (QLXF) via the warming and tonifying of kidney yang, promotion of blood circulation, and clearing of meridians. First, network pharmacology analysis was used to screen and identify possible pathways for BPH treatment with QLXF. Subsequently, molecular docking analysis helped explore the mechanism of action by which the components of QLXF affected androgen receptor (AR) and type 5 phosphodiesterase inhibitor (PDE-5) levels. Targets for treatment with QLXF were identified from the online Mendelian inheritance in man and DisGeNET databases. BPH-related genes were identified using GeneCards and online Mendelian inheritance in man databases, and their intersection was used to construct a protein-protein interaction network analysis graph. Subsequently, gene ontology and Kyoto encyclopedia of genes and genomes (KEGG) pathway enrichment analyses were performed. The semiflexible docking of the ingredients of QLXF acting on the 2 targets was performed via molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation, to elucidate the mechanism of action by which the active ingredients affect AR and PDE-5 levels further. This enabled us to explore the pattern of interactions between small active ingredient molecules, the target protein, and the stability after binding at the microscopic level. Gene ontology enrichment analysis showed that QLXF affected several processes, such as DNA transcription factor binding, kinase binding, protein homodimerization activity, protein structure domain-specific binding, and protein-coupled amine receptor activity in BPH patients. KEGG results showed that chemical carcinogenic reactive oxidative species and the JAK-STAT, Pl3k-Akt, FoxO, NF-kappaB, and other pathways were significantly enriched. Conducting molecular docking studies to investigate the interaction of active components from QLXF with AR and PDE-5, it was found that MOL002260 may possess the potential to inhibit PDE-5 activity, while MOL010578 may exhibit the capability to inhibit AR activity. QLXF is closely associated with various biological processes and KEGG signaling pathways related to BPH. The active ingredients of QLXF were investigated for their interactions with AR and PDE-5, with a primary focus on the small molecules MOL002260 and MOL010578.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在从中医理论角度探讨良性前列腺增生的历史研究进展，以及前列行方（QLXF）通过温补肾阳、活血通络治疗良性前列腺增生（BPH）的机制。首先，采用网络药理学分析筛选并确定QLXF治疗BPH的可能通路。随后，分子对接分析帮助探索QLXF成分影响雄激素受体（AR）和5型磷酸二酯酶抑制剂（PDE-5）水平的作用机制。从在线人类孟德尔遗传（OMIM）和DisGeNET数据库中识别QLXF治疗的靶点。利用GeneCards和在线人类孟德尔遗传数据库识别BPH相关基因，并取其交集构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析图。随后，进行基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路富集分析。通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟，对QLXF成分作用于两个靶点的半柔性对接进行了研究，以进一步阐明活性成分影响AR和PDE-5水平的作用机制。这使我们能够在微观层面探索小活性成分分子、靶蛋白之间的相互作用模式及结合后的稳定性。GO富集分析显示，QLXF影响BPH患者中的多个过程，如DNA转录因子结合、激酶结合、蛋白质同源二聚化活性、蛋白质结构域特异性结合以及蛋白质偶联胺受体活性。KEGG结果显示，化学致癌活性氧物种以及JAK-STAT、Pl3k-Akt、FoxO、NF-kappaB等通路显著富集。通过分子对接研究QLXF活性成分与AR和PDE-5的相互作用，发现MOL002260可能具有抑制PDE-5活性的潜力，而MOL010578可能表现出抑制AR活性的能力。QLXF与BPH相关的多种生物过程和KEGG信号通路密切相关。研究了QLXF活性成分与AR和PDE-5的相互作用，重点关注小分子MOL002260和MOL010578。
